indicators.label: Executive sponsor engaged
indicators.definition: A customer executive with budget authority is actively involved: attends, asks questions, or makes commitments.

indicators.label: Customer speaks to value
indicators.definition: Customer stakeholders describe business value in their own words, unprompted by the vendor.

indicators.label: Multi-threaded relationship
indicators.definition: The relationship spans several stakeholders and levels, not a single admin or operator.

indicators.label: Sponsor stability
indicators.definition: No recent or pending departure, reorganization, or ownership gap affecting the sponsor or champion.

indicators.label: Recent executive contact
indicators.definition: Days since the customer executive sponsor (VP or above, or the named sponsor) last engaged directly with the vendor team.

rule.evidenceTemplate: {value} days since the executive sponsor last engaged.

indicators.label: Business objectives defined
indicators.definition: Specific business objectives for the investment are named and agreed by the customer.

indicators.label: KPIs with baselines
indicators.definition: Measurable KPIs exist with a pre-investment baseline the customer accepts.

indicators.label: Outcomes evidenced
indicators.definition: Specific, measured outcomes are attributed to the solution, with a named source.

indicators.label: Customer owns the story
indicators.definition: The value story is told by the customer, not only by the vendor.

indicators.label: Breadth of use
indicators.definition: Usage spans the intended teams, regions, or user groups rather than a single power user.

indicators.label: Core use cases in workflow
indicators.definition: Priority use cases are live and embedded in day-to-day work; outputs are acted on.

indicators.label: No material blockers
indicators.definition: Strong means no unresolved technical or organizational blockers to the next adoption milestone.

indicators.label: License utilization
indicators.definition: Share of licensed or entitled capacity in active use, from product telemetry.

rule.evidenceTemplate: {value}% of licensed or entitled capacity in active use.

indicators.label: Healthy meeting cadence
indicators.definition: Regular meetings happen as planned; few cancellations or long gaps.

indicators.label: Customer drives the agenda
indicators.definition: The customer raises needs, challenges the vendor, and talks more than they listen.

indicators.label: Forward-looking interest
indicators.definition: The customer explores new teams, use cases, or capabilities.

overall.healthyRule: At least 3 green pillars and no red pillars
overall.atRiskRule: Champion or ROI red, or 2 or more red pillars

archetypes.label: The Expanding Account
archetypes.description: Healthy, growing, asking about new capabilities.

archetypes.label: The Advocate
archetypes.description: Champion engaged, ROI documented, reference candidate.

archetypes.label: The Abandoned Account
archetypes.description: Relationship has effectively lapsed at all levels.

archetypes.label: The Ghost
archetypes.description: Single-threaded, no value narrative, renewal at risk.

archetypes.label: The Headless Account
archetypes.description: Real usage and results, but no business-level champion holding it.

archetypes.label: The Unproven Investment
archetypes.description: Heavy, healthy usage with no measured business outcome behind it.

archetypes.label: The Stalled Rollout
archetypes.description: Implementation blockers are holding back activation and the value story.

archetypes.label: The Friend
archetypes.description: Warm relationship but little adoption. A false positive.

archetypes.label: The Skeptic
archetypes.description: Low adoption and theoretical ROI. Often a change management issue.

archetypes.label: The Power User
archetypes.description: One super-user carries the account; the wider team is not engaged.

archetypes.label: The Steady Account
archetypes.description: Generally healthy with specific gaps to close.

archetypes.label: Mixed Signals
archetypes.description: No clear pattern. Validate the gaps before acting.
